boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Bryn Mawr College
boards.description: Late-night culture at Bryn Mawr balances on-campus student-run cafes with local Main Line staples that keep Mawrters fueled through finals and traditions.

cards.title: The Lusty Cup
cards.subtitle: Canaday Library
cards.notes: Visit this student-run cafe in the Canaday Library basement for coffee and snacks during late-night study sessions.
cards.short_summary: A student-run late-night cafe located in the basement of Canaday Library.
cards.evidence_claim: The Lusty Cup is a late-night café located in the basement of Canaday Library, open Sunday-Thursday from 8 p.m. to Midnight during the semester.
cards.source_title: The Lusty Cup - Bryn Mawr College
cards.access_notes: Open Sunday-Thursday 8 p.m. to Midnight during the academic semester.

cards.title: UnCommon Grounds
cards.subtitle: Bern Schwartz Fitness and Athletic Center
cards.notes: Stop by the Campus Center for a late-night sandwich or snack when the main dining halls have closed for the day.
cards.short_summary: A campus cafe offering late-night kitchen service and coffee in the Campus Center.
cards.evidence_claim: UnCommon Grounds is open until 11 p.m. daily, with the kitchen also serving food until 11 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Open daily until 11 p.m. during the academic semester.

cards.title: Wawa
cards.subtitle: Lancaster Avenue
cards.notes: Walk to this 24-hour staple for a custom hoagie or a Sizzli breakfast sandwich at any hour of the night.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour convenience store and deli that serves as a primary late-night destination for students.
cards.evidence_claim: The Wawa at 413 Lancaster Ave is open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.
cards.access_notes: Open 24/7 for walk-in and ordering.

cards.title: Insomnia Cookies
cards.subtitle: Lancaster Avenue
cards.notes: Order warm cookies for delivery or pickup until the early morning hours during intense study sessions.
cards.short_summary: A bakery specializing in late-night cookie delivery and pickup near campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Insomnia Cookies in Bryn Mawr offers delivery and pickup until 1 a.m. or later most nights.
cards.access_notes: Open until 1 a.m. Sunday-Wednesday and 3 a.m. Thursday-Saturday.

cards.title: Hope's Cookies
cards.subtitle: West Lancaster Avenue
cards.notes: Visit this local favorite for gourmet cookies and ice cream, a frequent destination for students walking from campus.
cards.short_summary: A long-standing local cookie and ice cream shop popular with the Bryn Mawr community.
cards.evidence_claim: Hope's Cookies is open until 9:30 p.m. on weekdays and 10:30 p.m. on Fridays and Saturdays.
cards.access_notes: Open until 9:30 p.m. Sunday-Thursday and 10:30 p.m. Friday-Saturday.

cards.title: Campus Corner Pizza
cards.subtitle: Lancaster Avenue
cards.notes: Head to this nearby pizzeria for late-night slices and hoagies, a common stop for students in the Bi-College community.
cards.short_summary: A local pizzeria serving the Bryn Mawr and Villanova communities with late hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Campus Corner Pizza is open until 11 p.m. on Monday and Thursday, and until Midnight on Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Open until 11 p.m. or Midnight depending on the day.

cards.title: El Limon
cards.subtitle: Lancaster Avenue
cards.notes: Enjoy tacos and quesadillas at this student-favorite Mexican spot that stays open until 10 p.m. daily.
cards.short_summary: A popular Mexican restaurant known for its authentic tacos and student-friendly atmosphere.
cards.evidence_claim: El Limon Bryn Mawr is open until 10 p.m. Monday through Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Open until 10 p.m. most nights.

cards.title: New Dorm Dining Hall
cards.subtitle: New Dorm
cards.notes: Take advantage of the late dinner hours at NDDH, which serves students until 9 p.m. on weeknights.
cards.short_summary: One of the two main campus dining halls, offering the latest dinner service on campus.
cards.evidence_claim: New Dorm Dining Hall serves dinner until 9 p.m. Monday through Thursday during the semester.
cards.source_title: New Dorm Dining Hall - Bryn Mawr College
cards.access_notes: Dinner service available until 9 p.m. Monday-Thursday.

cards.title: Midnight Breakfast
cards.subtitle: Erdman Dining Hall
cards.notes: Join the campus community for a free late-night breakfast buffet during finals week to de-stress with peers.
cards.short_summary: A traditional late-night event where faculty and staff serve breakfast to students during finals.
cards.evidence_claim: Bryn Mawr hosts a Midnight Breakfast event for students featuring a free breakfast buffet and activities.
cards.access_notes: Occurs as a special event during finals week; typically starts at 10 p.m. or later.

cards.title: Snap Custom Pizza
cards.subtitle: Lancaster Avenue
cards.notes: Build your own pizza at this quick-service spot that remains open until 10 p.m. for late-night cravings.
cards.short_summary: A customizable pizza shop located near campus that is a popular student dinner and late-snack spot.
cards.evidence_claim: Snap Custom Pizza in Bryn Mawr is open until 10 p.m. daily.
cards.source_title: Bryn Mawr/Rosemont | Hours + Location - Snap Custom Pizza
cards.access_notes: Open until 10 p.m. daily.

boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Discover the specific study nooks, late-night cafes, and scenic outdoor spots where Bryn Mawr students actually spend their time between classes and after hours.

cards.title: Late-Night Study at The Lusty Cup
cards.subtitle: Canaday Library Basement
cards.notes: Visit this student-run cafe in the library basement for late-night coffee and snacks; it is a primary social study hub open until midnight most weeknights.
cards.short_summary: A student-run late-night cafe and study space located in the basement of Canaday Library.
cards.evidence_claim: The Lusty Cup is a late-night café located on the lower floor of Canaday Library, where students can purchase coffee or snacks.
cards.access_notes: Open Sunday 5:00 PM to midnight and Monday-Friday 8:00 PM to midnight for service; space is accessible to students during library hours.

cards.title: Sunbathing and Reading at Rhoads Beach
cards.subtitle: Grassy Slope near Rhoads Hall
cards.notes: Relax on this rolling grassy hill for outdoor reading or picnicking; it is a favorite spot for students to gather when the weather is warm.
cards.short_summary: A popular rolling grassy area used by students for outdoor studying and socializing near Rhoads Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: Rhoads Beach is the rolling, grassy area on top of which Rhoads sits, where students collaborate and relax.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor public campus area accessible 24/7.

cards.title: The Nook at UnCommon Grounds
cards.subtitle: Bernath Campus Center
cards.notes: Grab a seat in the cozy nook area for a social study session; this cafe is known for its matcha lattes and vibrant student atmosphere.
cards.short_summary: A central campus cafe in the Campus Center featuring a cozy nook for social studying.
cards.evidence_claim: Uncommon Grounds cafe located inside the campus center has a nook with couches and chairs for late-night reading.
cards.access_notes: Open weekdays from 8:00 AM to 11:00 PM during the academic semester.

cards.title: Natural Light in the Carpenter Atrium
cards.subtitle: Rhys Carpenter Library
cards.notes: Study at the large tables overlooking the glass atrium for maximum natural light; it is often cited by students as a quieter alternative to Canaday.
cards.short_summary: A spacious, light-filled study area within the Rhys Carpenter Library featuring large tables and an open atrium.
cards.evidence_claim: The big tables near the atrium wall in Carpenter Library make a great study area with sunlight filtering in from the top.
cards.access_notes: Open to the public weekdays 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM; Tri-Co ID required after 6:00 PM and on weekends.

cards.title: Chalkboard Brainstorming in Park
cards.subtitle: Marion Edwards Park Science Center
cards.notes: Use the floor-to-ceiling chalkboards on the ground floor to map out equations or project ideas; the moveable tables allow for easy group work.
cards.short_summary: A collaborative study area in the science building equipped with extensive chalkboard space and flexible seating.
cards.evidence_claim: The ground floor of Park is a great study space with chalkboards surrounding every corner to map out equations.
cards.source_title: Renovation Revitalizes Park Science Center - Bryn Mawr College
cards.access_notes: Accessible during building hours; typically open late for students in STEM majors.

cards.title: Quiet Reflection in the Cloisters
cards.subtitle: Old Library (formerly M. Carey Thomas)
cards.notes: Walk through the Gothic-style arcade to find a quiet outdoor courtyard with a central fountain; it is a prime spot for reading in a historic setting.
cards.short_summary: A historic Gothic courtyard and arcade located within the Old Library building.
cards.evidence_claim: The Cloisters became an active student space for plays and activities, featuring a large water fountain and stone arcade.
cards.source_title: History of Old Library - Bryn Mawr College
cards.access_notes: Accessible through the Old Library during building hours; often used for student traditions.

cards.title: Hidden Study in the London Room
cards.subtitle: Old Library / Thomas Hall
cards.notes: Find this tucked-away room filled with books about England for a quiet, out-of-the-way study experience with elegant windows.
cards.short_summary: A small, specialized study room in the Old Library known for its quiet atmosphere and collection of British literature.
cards.evidence_claim: The London Room is a cozy room down a little corridor in College Hall (Old Library) with elegant windows and books about England.
cards.source_title: Top Study Spaces at Bryn Mawr - The Bi-College News
cards.access_notes: Located within the Old Library; accessible during standard building hours.

cards.title: Sunlight and Swivel Chairs in Dalton
cards.subtitle: Dalton Hall
cards.notes: Head to the upper floors of the glass atrium for cushiony chairs and views of the campus; note that power outlets are limited here.
cards.short_summary: A modern glass-walled atrium in Dalton Hall offering bright, comfortable seating for reading.
cards.evidence_claim: The glass atrium of Dalton Hall offers a beautiful view of campus with cushiony, swiveling chairs on the second or third floor.
cards.source_title: Best Study Spaces at Bryn Mawr - Her Campus
cards.access_notes: Accessible during academic building hours.

cards.title: Old-School Focus in the Stacks
cards.subtitle: Old Library Stacks
cards.notes: Use the metal desks in the older part of the library for a quiet, slightly darker environment perfect for deep concentration.
cards.short_summary: Traditional library carrels located in the historic Old Library stacks, favored for silent study.
cards.evidence_claim: Old Library carrels are located in the older part of the building; it is a quiet, slightly darker space with metal desks.
cards.access_notes: Accessible through the Carpenter Library entrance; open during library hours.

cards.title: The Hidden Gem Buffet at Wyndham
cards.subtitle: Wyndham Alumnae House
cards.notes: Visit this 18th-century farmhouse for a hot and cold lunch buffet; it is a quiet alternative to the main dining halls for a formal meal.
cards.short_summary: A historic restaurant located in the Wyndham Alumnae House offering lunch buffets and à la carte options.
cards.evidence_claim: The Restaurant at Wyndham is open for its hot and cold buffet Tuesday through Thursday from 11:30 a.m. to 1:30 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Open Tuesday-Thursday 11:30 AM to 1:30 PM during the semester; open to students, faculty, and the public.

boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Explore free social spaces and activities at Bryn Mawr College, from historic reading rooms and meditative labyrinths to seasonal traditions and modern science atriums.

cards.title: Walk the Labyrinth
cards.subtitle: A meditative turf path gifted by McBride Scholars
cards.notes: Walk this seven-ring turf path for quiet reflection. It is located behind the Rhodes South residence hall and is open to the public from sunrise to sunset.
cards.short_summary: A permanent outdoor turf labyrinth designed for meditation and contemplation on the south side of campus.
cards.evidence_claim: The labyrinth is part of the campus inventory of gardens and is accessible to the public for recreational walks and meditation.
cards.source_title: Revisiting the Eternal Labyrinth - Bryn Mawr College
cards.access_notes: Open daily from sunrise to sunset; located near Rhoads Hall.

cards.title: Study in the Great Hall
cards.subtitle: Historic reading room in the Old Library
cards.notes: Visit this iconic Gothic Revival space for quiet study or public lectures. It features high timber ceilings and leaded glass windows.
cards.short_summary: A grand, historic reading room in the Old Library used for quiet study, performances, and major college traditions.
cards.evidence_claim: The Great Hall is primarily a space for performances, readings, lectures, and public gatherings, and serves as a central reading room.
cards.source_title: History of Old Library - Bryn Mawr College
cards.access_notes: Accessible to the campus community and visitors during building hours; check for event closures.

cards.title: Sled at Rhoads Beach
cards.subtitle: A rolling grassy slope behind Rhoads Hall
cards.notes: Join students on this popular hill for sunbathing in the spring or sledding during winter snows. It offers a wide, open view of the campus edge.
cards.short_summary: A signature campus lawn known as 'The Beach,' popular for outdoor relaxation and seasonal sledding.
cards.evidence_claim: Rhoads Beach is the rolling, grassy area on top of which Rhoads sits, used for activities like sledding and sunbathing.
cards.access_notes: Publicly accessible outdoor lawn area located behind Rhoads Hall.

cards.title: Relax by the Cloisters Fountain
cards.subtitle: Secluded courtyard in the Old Library
cards.notes: Sit on the grass in this enclosed courtyard to enjoy the central fountain. It is the site of the annual Lantern Night tradition.
cards.short_summary: An open-air courtyard within the Old Library featuring a central fountain and braid-patterned pathways.
cards.evidence_claim: The Cloisters is an open, outdoor courtyard in the center of Old Library where audience members can sit on the grass.
cards.source_title: Alternative Outdoor Performance Spaces - Bryn Mawr College
cards.access_notes: Accessible through the Old Library building; open to the public during building hours.

cards.title: Visit the Park Science Atrium
cards.subtitle: Modern glass-walled social hub
cards.notes: Gather in this bright, multi-story atrium for group work or a coffee break. It serves as the main entrance to the renovated Park Science Center.
cards.short_summary: A modern, glass-walled atrium in the Park Science Center designed for student collaboration and social interaction.
cards.evidence_claim: The Park renovation dramatically opened up the building with the Johanna Alderfer Harris '51 Atrium for student study and social space.
cards.source_title: Renovation Revitalizes Park Science Center - Bryn Mawr College
cards.access_notes: Located at 900 New Gulph Road; open during academic building hours.

cards.title: Browse the 1912 Gallery
cards.subtitle: Exhibition space in Canaday Library
cards.notes: View rotating exhibits of rare books and artifacts from the college's Special Collections. The gallery is open to the public on weekdays.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated exhibition space within Canaday Library showcasing the college's rare book and archival collections.
cards.evidence_claim: The 1912 Gallery functions as an exhibition and learning space open to TriCo community members and public visitors.
cards.access_notes: Open Monday-Friday, 9am-5pm; located on the first floor of Canaday Library.

cards.title: Lounge on Carpenter Roof
cards.subtitle: Elevated lawn behind the Old Library
cards.notes: Enjoy the sun on this grassy rooftop lawn. It features a concrete landing that often serves as a stage for outdoor student performances.
cards.short_summary: A unique green roof on Carpenter Library that provides an elevated lawn for relaxation and small events.
cards.evidence_claim: Carpenter Roof is the lawn that is the roof of Carpenter Library, located behind Old Library; it is a sunny, outdoor space.
cards.source_title: Alternative Outdoor Performance Spaces - Bryn Mawr College
cards.access_notes: Publicly accessible outdoor space located behind the Old Library building.

cards.title: Hang in Senior Row Hammocks
cards.subtitle: Shaded path along Merion Green
cards.notes: Find a spot in one of the hammocks along this historic path. While the row is a senior tradition, the hammocks are a favorite for all to relax.
cards.short_summary: A scenic, tree-lined walkway along Merion Green equipped with hammocks for student use.
cards.evidence_claim: Students can do homework in a hammock on Senior Row, a popular spot for relaxing on campus.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor path along Merion Green; hammocks are available seasonally.

cards.title: Hike Morris Woods
cards.subtitle: Campus woodland with nature trails
cards.notes: Explore the trails through this 18-acre woodland on the edge of campus. It is a quiet spot for nature walks and environmental study.
cards.short_summary: A preserved woodland area on the Bryn Mawr campus featuring trails for hiking and mindfulness breaks.
cards.evidence_claim: Morris Woods is used for hikes and mindfulness breaks, especially during events like Earth Week.
cards.source_title: Earth Week: SLG Morris Woods Hike - Bryn Mawr College
cards.access_notes: Open to the public; trails are accessible from the north side of campus near the athletic fields.

cards.title: Sit at the Moon Bench
cards.subtitle: A crescent-shaped stone bench on Merion Green
cards.notes: Visit this stone bench for a view across Merion Green. It is a central meeting spot for students and a fixture of campus lore.
cards.short_summary: A distinctive crescent-shaped stone bench located on Merion Green, serving as a social landmark.
cards.evidence_claim: The Moon Bench is a recognized outdoor location on Merion Green used for seating and community gatherings.
cards.source_title: Updated Campus Meeting and Event Space Information - Bryn Mawr College
cards.access_notes: Located outdoors on Merion Green; open to the public 24/7.

boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Discover ten distinct study environments across Bryn Mawr College, from historic reading rooms to modern science hubs and late-night cafes.

cards.title: Canaday Library Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Main campus library with diverse seating
cards.notes: Visit the first floor for Quita's Corner pleasure reading or head to upper floors for quiet carrels and group study rooms.
cards.short_summary: The central library offering a mix of collaborative zones, quiet carrels, and specialized rooms like the Writing Center.
cards.evidence_claim: Canaday Library features Quita's Corner on the first floor, group study rooms on the 3rd floor, and is the main campus library.
cards.access_notes: Open to students with OneCard; hours vary by semester, typically opening at 9am.

cards.title: Carpenter Library Atrium
cards.subtitle: Sunlit tables near the glass wall
cards.notes: Spread out at the large tables near the atrium wall to enjoy natural light and views of the surrounding architecture.
cards.short_summary: A modern, spacious library addition known for its high ceilings, natural light, and proximity to the Old Library.
cards.evidence_claim: Carpenter Library features over 100 carrels and large tables near the atrium wall that provide significant natural light.
cards.access_notes: Accessible to the Tri-Co community; features quiet carrels and collaborative classrooms.

cards.title: Collier Science Library Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Quiet research space in Park Science Center
cards.notes: Head to the third floor of Park Science for a quiet environment ideal for STEM research and focused individual work.
cards.short_summary: Located within the Park Science Center, this library offers specialized collections and quiet reading areas.
cards.evidence_claim: The Collier Science Library Reading Room is located on the third floor of the Marion Park Science Building.
cards.source_title: Collier Science Library - Bryn Mawr College
cards.access_notes: Open for studying and collaborating; includes group and individual study rooms reservable via LibCal.

cards.title: Quita Woodward Room
cards.subtitle: Historic lounge in the Old Library
cards.notes: Find a cozy armchair among floor-to-ceiling bookshelves for a quiet, traditional academic atmosphere.
cards.short_summary: A wood-paneled, historic room in the Old Library building used for quiet study and small gatherings.
cards.evidence_claim: The Quita Woodward Room is located in the Old Library and features casual chairs and bookshelves.
cards.access_notes: Located in the Old Library; typically available for quiet study when not reserved for events.

cards.title: The Lusty Cup
cards.subtitle: Late-night student-run cafe
cards.notes: Visit this basement cafe in Canaday Library for a social study environment and late-night caffeine.
cards.short_summary: A student-run cafe located in the basement of Canaday Library, popular for late-night study sessions.
cards.evidence_claim: The Lusty Cup is a late-night café located on the lower floor of Canaday Library.
cards.source_title: The Lusty Cup - Bryn Mawr College
cards.access_notes: Open late nights, typically 8pm-12am; check current semester hours.

cards.title: Uncommon Grounds
cards.subtitle: Campus Center social study hub
cards.notes: Grab a coffee and find a spot in the lounge for group work or casual reading in a lively atmosphere.
cards.short_summary: The primary campus cafe located in the Bern Schwartz Gymnasium/Campus Center complex.
cards.evidence_claim: Uncommon Grounds is located inside the Campus Center and offers a social atmosphere for studying.
cards.access_notes: Open during daytime and evening hours; seating is open to all students.

cards.title: Dalton Hall Atrium
cards.subtitle: Glass-walled study area
cards.notes: Use the swiveling chairs on the upper floors of the atrium for a bright space with views of the campus green.
cards.short_summary: A modern glass atrium within the historic Dalton Hall providing natural light and comfortable seating.
cards.evidence_claim: The glass atrium of Dalton Hall offers swiveling chairs and significant natural light for studying.
cards.access_notes: Open during building hours; seating is available on a first-come, first-served basis.

cards.title: Park Science Center Ground Floor
cards.subtitle: Collaborative space with chalkboards
cards.notes: Utilize the moveable tables and wall-to-wall chalkboards for mapping out complex equations or group projects.
cards.short_summary: A recently renovated science hub featuring open collaborative spaces and modern academic facilities.
cards.evidence_claim: The ground floor of Park Science Center features chalkboards and moveable tables for student use.
cards.source_title: Renovation Revitalizes Park Science Center - Bryn Mawr College
cards.access_notes: Accessible during building hours; renovated in 2025 to enhance collaborative study areas.

cards.title: The London Room
cards.subtitle: Secluded study nook in Thomas Hall
cards.notes: Locate this quiet room off the Great Hall for a focused session surrounded by historic British literature.
cards.short_summary: A small, quiet study room located within Thomas Hall (Old Library) known for its cozy atmosphere.
cards.evidence_claim: The London Room is a cozy room in Thomas Hall with elegant windows and books about England.
cards.access_notes: Accessible via the Great Hall; limited seating makes it a quiet, sought-after spot.

cards.title: New Dorm Dining Hall Lounge
cards.subtitle: Versatile dining and study area
cards.notes: Use the versatile dining rooms for group meetings or a quiet meal while catching up on reading.
cards.short_summary: A modern dining facility that doubles as a student gathering and study space outside of peak meal times.
cards.evidence_claim: New Dorm Dining Hall offers versatile dining rooms suitable for group meetings of eight or more.
cards.source_title: New Dorm Dining Hall - Bryn Mawr College
cards.access_notes: Open during dining hours; features conference rooms and diverse seating options.

boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each

cards.title: The 800 Block of Lancaster
cards.subtitle: West Lancaster Avenue
cards.notes: Visit this historic 1926 theater for independent films and student-discounted tickets just steps from the Bryn Mawr train station.
cards.short_summary: A historic non-profit movie theater and cultural hub on Lancaster Avenue.
cards.evidence_claim: The Bryn Mawr Film Institute offers student discount tickets and is a central cultural landmark in downtown Bryn Mawr.
cards.access_notes: Open daily for screenings; check website for specific showtimes and student pricing.

cards.title: The 0 Block of South Bryn Mawr
cards.subtitle: South Bryn Mawr Avenue
cards.notes: Utilize the 'Reading Porch' or the quiet top-floor study areas in this public library located only a few blocks from campus.
cards.short_summary: A large public library serving as a popular off-campus study alternative for students.
cards.evidence_claim: Ludington Library is located a few blocks from campus and features a 'Reading Porch' where food and beverages are permitted.
cards.source_title: My favorite off-campus spots | Rachel Hertzberg's Banter Blog
cards.access_notes: Public access during standard library hours; library card required for borrowing but not for on-site study.

cards.title: The 800 Block of Morris

cards.title: The 900 Block of Lancaster

cards.notes: Experience this coffee shop housed in a former bus terminal; note that it intentionally does not offer WiFi to encourage conversation.

cards.evidence_claim: La Colombe is located in the Bryn Mawr Village development and purposefully does not offer WiFi to promote social interaction.
cards.source_title: New Bryn Mawr Village Shopping Center - The Villanovan
cards.access_notes: Open daily; large seating area available for groups.

cards.title: The 0 Block of Morris

cards.source_title: Directions to Bryn Mawr College | SEPTA, PHL & Driving Info

cards.title: The 1100 Block of Lancaster
cards.subtitle: West Lancaster Avenue
cards.notes: Stop by for freshly baked gourmet cookies, a long-standing tradition for students looking for a late-afternoon treat.
cards.short_summary: A well-known local bakery specializing in a wide variety of gourmet cookies.
cards.evidence_claim: Hope's Cookies is cited as a student favorite for freshly-baked gourmet cookies in the Bryn Mawr area.
cards.source_title: A Student's Guide to Bryn Mawr Town
cards.access_notes: Open daily; shares a building with Snap Custom Pizza.

cards.title: The 800 Block of Lancaster
cards.subtitle: West Lancaster Avenue
cards.notes: Enjoy shared portions of Indian dishes at this restaurant, a frequent choice for student group dinners and movie nights.
cards.short_summary: A popular Indian restaurant offering dine-in and delivery services to the college community.
cards.evidence_claim: Tiffin Indian Cuisine is a student favorite for dinners and offers delivery to the Bryn Mawr campus.
cards.source_title: A Student's Guide to Bryn Mawr Town
cards.access_notes: Open for lunch and dinner; offers free delivery for local orders.

cards.title: The 800 Block of Lancaster
cards.subtitle: West Lancaster Avenue
cards.notes: Explore this whimsical toy store located just a 7-minute walk from campus, popular for unique gifts and collectibles.
cards.short_summary: A local independent toy store known for its curated selection of unique items.
cards.evidence_claim: Lucky Duck Toys is a 7-minute walk from campus and is recommended for students seeking whimsical gifts.
cards.source_title: A Student's Guide to Bryn Mawr Town
cards.access_notes: Open daily; located in the heart of the downtown business district.

cards.title: The 600 Block of Lancaster
cards.subtitle: West Lancaster Avenue
cards.notes: Shop for groceries and essentials at this supermarket, which is the primary full-service grocery store within walking distance.
cards.short_summary: The main local supermarket serving the Bryn Mawr student and residential community.
cards.evidence_claim: ACME Markets at 601 W Lancaster Ave is the local supermarket for the Bryn Mawr area.
cards.source_title: Grocery Store Near Me - ACME Markets in Bryn Mawr, PA

cards.title: The 800 Block of Lancaster

cards.notes: Visit this newly opened bakery and cafe for sourdough loaves and pastries, featuring a rear entrance for easier access.
cards.short_summary: A new addition to the Lancaster Avenue corridor offering high-quality baked goods and cafe service.
cards.evidence_claim: The Buttery opened its Bryn Mawr location at 836 W. Lancaster Avenue in June 2026.
cards.source_title: Bryn Mawr Summer 2026: What's New on Lancaster Avenue

boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Explore the unique rituals and historic traditions of Bryn Mawr College, from lantern ceremonies to May Day festivities.

cards.title: Lantern Night
cards.subtitle: The Passing of Knowledge
cards.notes: First-year students receive lanterns in their class color from sophomores in the Old Library Cloisters to symbolize the passing of knowledge.
cards.short_summary: A cornerstone tradition where first-years receive colored lanterns in the Old Library Cloisters.
cards.evidence_claim: Lantern Night is an official event occurring in the Cloisters at nightfall every October where first-years receive lanterns from sophomores.
cards.access_notes: Held annually in October; primarily for the campus community.

cards.title: May Day
cards.subtitle: Medieval End-of-Year Festival
cards.notes: Celebrate the end of classes with maypole dancing, strawberries and cream, and students wearing all-white outfits on Merion Green.
cards.short_summary: An all-day medieval-themed festival held on the Sunday after the last week of classes.
cards.evidence_claim: May Day features maypole dancing, a strawberries and cream breakfast, and students wearing white outfits on Merion Green.
cards.access_notes: Occurs on the Sunday after the final week of spring classes.

cards.title: Parade Night
cards.subtitle: First Week Celebration
cards.notes: Mark the end of the first week of classes with a parade from Erdman to Taylor Hall, ending in the year's first Step Sing.
cards.short_summary: A celebratory parade and singing event held at the conclusion of the first week of fall classes.
cards.evidence_claim: Parade Night celebrates the completion of the first week of classes with a parade and the first Step Sing of the year.
cards.access_notes: Held on the Friday evening of the first week of fall classes.

cards.title: Step Sings
cards.subtitle: Class Competitive Singing
cards.notes: Gather on the steps of Taylor Hall to sing traditional college songs and class-specific parodies in a friendly competition.
cards.short_summary: Recurring outdoor singing events where classes compete through traditional and parody songs.
cards.evidence_claim: Step Sings are held multiple times a year, including after Parade Night, Lantern Night, and May Day.
cards.access_notes: Open to the campus community; held on the steps of Taylor Hall.

cards.title: Offerings to Athena
cards.subtitle: Good Luck Rituals
cards.notes: Leave small offerings like flowers or notes at the statue of Athena in Thomas Great Hall for good luck during exams.
cards.short_summary: A practice of leaving tokens at the Athena statue to seek academic success or personal support.
cards.evidence_claim: Students make offerings to the statue of Athena in Thomas Great Hall for good luck and support through challenges.
cards.access_notes: The statue is located inside Thomas Great Hall, accessible during building hours.

cards.title: Welcome the First Years (WTF) Week
cards.subtitle: Winter Bonding Rituals
cards.notes: Participate in a week of silly tasks, performances, and bonding activities in February to welcome first-years into the community.
cards.short_summary: A mid-winter tradition focused on building bonds between upperclassmen and first-year students.
cards.evidence_claim: WTF Week takes place in February and includes student performances, group activities, and individualized tasks.
cards.source_title: Welcome the First Years Week - Bryn Mawr College
cards.access_notes: Held annually in February; specific events occur in various campus locations.

cards.title: Class Colors
cards.subtitle: Elemental Identities
cards.notes: Each class is assigned one of four colors—dark blue, green, light blue, or red—representing water, air, fire, and earth.
cards.short_summary: A system where each class year is identified by a specific color and natural element.
cards.evidence_claim: Every student receives a lantern in their class color: dark blue, green, light blue, or red, representing the four elements.
cards.access_notes: Colors are assigned upon entry and follow the class through graduation.

cards.title: The Mugging
cards.subtitle: Class Identity Reveal
cards.notes: First-year students receive mugs in their class color and vote on their class song and parody during this early fall event.
cards.short_summary: An event where first-years receive their class-colored mugs and establish their class identity.
cards.evidence_claim: The Mugging involves first-years receiving mugs in their class color and voting on class songs.
cards.source_title: A Guide to Bryn Mawr College's Major Traditions
cards.access_notes: Typically held in Goodhart Hall or McPherson Auditorium during the first few weeks of classes.

cards.title: Garden Party
cards.subtitle: Commencement Celebration
cards.notes: Attend the traditional outdoor reception on Wyndham Green following the undergraduate Commencement ceremony.
cards.short_summary: The final official tradition for graduating seniors, featuring an outdoor reception.
cards.evidence_claim: Garden Party is the traditional outdoor party/reception that follows the undergraduate Commencement ceremony on Wyndham Green.
cards.access_notes: Held on the day of Commencement; open to graduates and their guests.

cards.title: Ringing the Taylor Bell
cards.subtitle: Final Exam Victory
cards.notes: Seniors celebrate the completion of their final undergraduate exams by ringing the bell in Taylor Hall.
cards.short_summary: A celebratory act performed by seniors upon finishing their last college exams.
cards.evidence_claim: Minor traditions include ringing the Taylor Hall bell when seniors' final exams are finished.
cards.access_notes: Occurs during finals week; specific to graduating seniors.

boards.title: Your First Weekend at Bryn Mawr College, Shared as Cards
boards.description: Build a plausible under-21-safe first-weekend sequence, not a ranking. Give each card one role in the sequence and use evergreen places or recurring behaviors rather than one-time events. Be conservative about hours, access, and travel time unless directly sourced.

cards.title: Arrive Through the Arch
cards.subtitle: Friday Morning Move-In
cards.notes: Pass through the iconic Pembroke Arch to check in. This central gateway serves as the primary landmark for new students arriving on campus for Customs week.
cards.short_summary: The historic stone gateway where new students officially enter campus life during move-in.
cards.evidence_claim: New students arrive and check in during the morning of move-in day, often passing through Pembroke Arch as a central campus landmark.
cards.access_notes: Open 24/7 as a pedestrian thoroughfare; vehicle access is restricted during move-in events.

cards.title: First Group Brunch
cards.subtitle: Saturday at 11:00 AM
cards.notes: Gather with your new hallmates for brunch in this Brutalist landmark. It is the primary weekend dining hub for the first-year community.
cards.short_summary: A distinctive Brutalist dining hall serving as the main social hub for weekend meals.
cards.evidence_claim: Erdman Dining Hall serves brunch from 11:00 AM to 1:30 PM on Saturdays and Sundays during the academic semester.
cards.source_title: Erdman Dining Hall - Bryn Mawr College
cards.access_notes: Requires a student meal plan or OneCard for entry during meal hours.

cards.title: Lawn Games and Lounging
cards.subtitle: Saturday Afternoon
cards.notes: Relax on the sloping lawn behind Rhoads Hall. Students frequently use this green space for frisbee, reading, and meeting new friends outdoors.
cards.short_summary: A popular grassy slope on campus used for outdoor recreation and social gatherings.
cards.evidence_claim: Rhoads Beach is a rolling, grassy area located behind Rhoads Hall used by students for outdoor activities.
cards.access_notes: Publicly accessible outdoor campus space.

cards.title: Explore the Bi-Co
cards.subtitle: Saturday Evening
cards.notes: Take the shuttle to Haverford College to see the other half of the Bi-College community. It is a quick 10-minute ride from Pembroke Arch.
cards.short_summary: The inter-campus shuttle connecting Bryn Mawr and Haverford students.
cards.evidence_claim: The Blue Bus provides transportation between Bryn Mawr and Haverford, with departures from Pembroke Arch on a regular weekend schedule.
cards.access_notes: Free for students with a valid Bi-Co or Tri-Co ID card.

cards.title: Late Night Study Break
cards.subtitle: Saturday at 9:00 PM
cards.notes: Visit this student-run cafe in the basement of Canaday Library for a late-night snack. It is a favorite spot for social study sessions.
cards.short_summary: A student-run cafe located in Canaday Library known for its late-night hours.
cards.evidence_claim: The Lusty Cup is a late-night cafe on the lower floor of Canaday Library, typically open from 8:00 PM to 12:00 AM.
cards.access_notes: Open late night during the academic year; check library hours for specific weekend access.

cards.title: Reflect in the Cloisters
cards.subtitle: Sunday Morning
cards.notes: Walk through the serene courtyard of the Old Library. This space is central to many college traditions and offers a quiet place for reflection.
cards.short_summary: A historic, Gothic-style courtyard within the Old Library building.
cards.evidence_claim: The Cloisters in the Old Library is an active student space used for quiet reflection and major traditions like Lantern Night.
cards.source_title: History of Old Library - Bryn Mawr College
cards.access_notes: Accessible to students during building hours; often used for quiet study.

cards.title: Prep for First Classes
cards.subtitle: Sunday Afternoon
cards.notes: Find a carrel or a table in Canaday to organize your syllabus and books. The library is the primary academic resource center on campus.
cards.short_summary: The main library on campus providing extensive study spaces and research resources.
cards.evidence_claim: Canaday Library is the main library at Bryn Mawr, offering various study spaces including Quita's Corner and computer labs.
cards.access_notes: Open to students with OneCard access; weekend hours typically start at 12:00 PM.

cards.title: Community Gathering
cards.subtitle: Sunday Evening
cards.notes: Join fellow students on the large central lawn for informal gatherings. It is the heart of campus and the site of many major outdoor events.
cards.short_summary: The central green space of the campus, used for major events and daily student life.
cards.evidence_claim: Merion Green is the central lawn of the college, hosting events like May Day and serving as a general student gathering spot.
cards.access_notes: Publicly accessible outdoor campus space.

cards.title: Afternoon Tea Tradition
cards.subtitle: Sunday at 4:00 PM
cards.notes: Experience the long-standing tradition of afternoon tea. It is a formal yet welcoming way to connect with the college's history and community.
cards.short_summary: A historic house on campus that hosts traditional afternoon tea services.
cards.evidence_claim: Wyndham Alumnae House offers afternoon tea, a tradition that has been part of the college experience for decades.
cards.access_notes: Tea service is available to the college community; check for specific student seating times.

cards.title: Safe Evening Transit
cards.subtitle: Sunday Night
cards.notes: Use the student-driven shuttle for a safe ride back to your dorm after a long weekend of exploring. It connects campus and local train stations.
cards.short_summary: A student-run evening transportation service for the Bryn Mawr community.
cards.evidence_claim: The Lantern Shuttle runs nightly from 7:00 PM to 1:00 AM, providing safe transport for students around campus and to local transit.
cards.access_notes: Available to all students with a valid Bryn Mawr ID; runs 7 PM - 1 AM daily.
